title.en: Markov models, N-grams, smoothing, and causal CNNs
title.zh: 马尔可夫模型、N-gram、平滑与因果卷积神经网络

en.a: State explicitly what information a recurrent state compresses and compare finite receptive fields with attention.
en.b: Derive count-based conditional probabilities as constrained maximum likelihood and explain smoothing as Bayesian prediction.

zh.a: 明确说明循环状态压缩了哪些信息，并比较有限感受野与注意力机制。
zh.b: 将基于计数的条件概率推导为约束最大似然估计，并将平滑解释为贝叶斯预测。
